name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "dev" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  code_quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Validate lockfile
        run: |
          pip-compile --generate-hashes pyproject.toml

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1

      - name: Run ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check .

      - name: Run ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format --check .

  unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/unit/ -xvs --tb=short -k "not api and not rate_limiting_realistic and not embedding_rate_limiting_realistic and not integration and not e2e and not cognify"

  cli_unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run CLI unit tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/unit/cli/ -xvs --tb=short

  telemetry_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run telemetry test
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/unit/telemetry/ -xvs --tb=short

  test_summary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [code_quality, unit_tests, cli_unit_tests, telemetry_test]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check job statuses
        run: |
          echo "Code Quality: ${{ needs.code_quality.result }}"
          echo "Unit Tests: ${{ needs.unit_tests.result }}"
          echo "CLI Unit Tests: ${{ needs.cli_unit_tests.result }}"
          echo "Telemetry Test: ${{ needs.telemetry_test.result }}"

      - name: Fail if any required job failed
        if: >
          (needs.code_quality.result != 'success') ||
          (needs.unit_tests.result != 'success') ||
          (needs.cli_unit_tests.result != 'success') ||
          (needs.telemetry_test.result != 'success')
        run: |
          exit 1
